title: Contribution: PDF report generator
symptom: Doctors often want reports that usually come from proprietary software, but xDrip+ users may not want their data stored in corporate cloud systems. The issue proposes a PDF report generator that parses the sqlite database directly to generate day plots, daily patterns with percentiles, carbs/bolus and ratio plots, and text stats.
evidence_quote: I've written a PDF report generator for exactly this purpose. It parses the sqlite db directly and generates day plots as well as the daily pattern with percentiles that all doctors seem to love, plus carbs/bolus and ratio plots, Text stats and so on.
